quest.title: An Air Race and an Alibi
quest.description: Could the air race be a trap set by Lamizana?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After the Iktomisaurus stops you, you suddenly find a letter in your hand...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's an invitation letter to the air race! There are so many time-related requirements... Oh well, it is a race, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon doesn't know what will happen, so be careful, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After the Qucusaurus stops you, you suddenly find a letter in your hand...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's an invitation letter to the air race! There are so many time-related requirements... Oh well, it is a race, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

talks.objective: Head to the starting point of the air race

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Are you ready now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need time to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll wait.

talks.objective: Complete all challenges in the air race

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew — We should be okay now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not only has the client who should've paid us gone missing, we've even been mistaken for the villain's accomplices. Talk about bad luck!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not our style to just lie down and take a beating, though. Let's hunt the truth! Paimon's worried about Taruka and Oberon, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That Lamizana... isn't reliable at all! But we don't have any other clues right now. Shall we... take a look at the scene of the incident? Y'know, the finish line?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've reached the finish line!

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: Congratulations! Heh, with your skills, you'd more than qualify to be a coach, I'd say!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lliwa wasn't that far behind us, so she should almost be here... Paimon sure hopes she and her Saurian are both fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But why aren't Taruka and Oberon at the finish line... Are they resting somewhere else? Should we look for them?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: He must be planning something dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Cooo?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Sigh, I wish I were you. All you do is eat crackers and fly. You don't have to worry about anything.

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Crooo!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: That wasn't supposed to be a compliment!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, did you find something? There's nothing here, though!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooo... Rawr! Raaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can see that you really want to tell her something. Gah, it would be nice to know what you're saying right now, but Paimon's no Saurian.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wroo...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me try.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh right! Maybe it's a clue that only Saurians can see.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: How could this have happened!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's what we wanted to ask you! What happened? Also, where are Taruka and Oberon?

dialogues.speaker: Paran
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm late! Something happened to the other contestants' Saurians... Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: What took you so long? Everything's a mess. Not even one single thing went according to plan...

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: What the heck are you guys talking about? I don't understand a word of it... And where's Taruka? Why isn't he here?

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: He was abducted, along with Oberon. It was those Saurians, they started attacking us like crazy just now and seized the chance to take him while I had my hands full protecting myself.

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Huh!? I—I have to go after him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you'll need a lead to do that, so hold your horses! Now that the person in question is here, Paimon can finally ask him about something we've wanted to know all along.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lamizana's plan.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You briefly explain Taruka's suspicions about Lamizana to everyone. To avoid having to explain too much, you skip the part about sneaking into the camp for the investigation...

dialogues.speaker: Paran
dialogues.text: Lamizana, tell them everything. Hiding stuff will only make things more complicated than they need to be.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Darn it... you're right — now's not the time to worry about my reputation. It's true that I had a plan, and it's one that Taruka wouldn't have liked.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: At first, it was the perfect ploy to start with. Taruka and I were racing on a different course from yours, but we had the same finish line, and since we started first, we'd get there first too.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: According to the plan, you... when you arrived at the finish line, Lliwa, you'd find that arrogant little br— Ahem, you'd see Taruka get attacked by a group of "out-of-control Saurians." Being young, they wouldn't pose any real threat.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: You'd definitely want to save your brother, but since your Saurian isn't the fighting type, I'd be the only person who could be relied on to save the day.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: That'd be the moment I'd show off my reliable side and drive away the out-of-control Saurians, saving both you and your brother. I hoped that you'd think better of me after that...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Don't people always say that the feeling of being nervous is similar to the feeling of being in love, which makes it easy for people to mistake...

choices.text: Hold on, you didn't factor me in at all?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: You were just here as a substitute so she could race...

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: You are just a temporary replacement we needed due to an accident! If everything had gone well, it'd all be over without you needing to lift a finger...

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: The plan... It required making too many people... and Saurians... do very specific things at specific times. Too many things could go wrong, which is what I told him as well...

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: If my Saurian's performance hadn't suddenly taken a dive, I definitely would've made it in time...! If I was here, there's no way I would've just watched Taruka get taken away...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... But this plan of yours didn't involve Taruka getting kidnapped for real, right?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: That's the problem, yes. The out-of-control Saurians weren't supposed to be really "out of control." After all, they've been trained and should understand instructions...

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: Ms. Quilla, I think you owe me a reasonable explanation.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: You doubt me? Now that's truly disappointing. Our little Saurians are indeed well-trained and well-behaved, and capable of following my instructions to the letter.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: They wouldn't hurt people for no reason, let alone kidnap Taruka and Oberon. Unless... Unless someone else has used some kind of vile means to control and forced them to do that.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Speaking of which, there's been a Saurian trafficker who's been active in the area recently — the notorious Hawka. I believe Paran knows him well, yes?

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Due to the nature of my business, I've heard a bit about his infamous deeds. He always gets his hands on any Saurian he sets his sights on.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: #I've also heard that Hawka has found a very capable helper recently — a {M#blond}{F#blonde} youth with a white pet. Doesn't really seem consistent with his status, does it?

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: If you ask me, his target is Oberon rather than Taruka. With a little training, that little Qucusaurus would have unlimited potential.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: It's possible that Hawka sneaked into the flight school with this person's help after taking a fancy to this little Saurian, and accidentally found out that he could take advantage of this opportunity...

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: #A {M#blond}{F#blonde} youth who recently sneaked into the flight school with a white pet... Isn't that {NICKNAME} and their white friend over there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon isn't some white pet! And we don't even know any "Hawka"...

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Uncle Hawka... Hawka is my uncle. He was exiled from our tribe a long time ago, and I've barely ever had any contact with him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, wait a minute. Wouldn't that make Paran and Carrewoof another "blond youth and white pet" pair? Ah... Oops. Taruka did remind Paimon not to say stuff like that, didn't he?

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: To be fair, Paran would've had many opportunities to commit the crime. He was there the day we were discussing the details of our plan, wasn't he?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: No, everyone knows Paran's the honest sort. I don't believe he'd do something like this.

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: He's also been very nice to Taruka and Oberon this entire time. I don't think he would do anything that would hurt them like this either.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Thank you...

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: #So {NICKNAME}'s still the more suspicious party...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whoa! {NICKNAME}, show them your Adventurer Handbook now! We're proper adventurers and aren't suspicious at all! Also... also... Aha! We don't have a motive!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We received a commission from Taruka. We won't be paid unless he is here to pay us. We earn our Mora on the up and up!

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: That makes sense too, but that leaves us without any other blond suspects...

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: No, it's also possible that there was never a blond suspect to begin with, and that Ms. Quilla is actually the suspicious one here, using false information to mislead us...

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: *sigh* So I take it you won't accept the notion that Paran might have betrayed you, then?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: Of course, I'm not the sort to doubt friends.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Fine, I just remembered another detail. On the night after we discussed the details, I saw a little Tepetlisaurus in the camp.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: That little Tepetlisaurus was very energetic and had special patterns on its horn... Why would there be a "lost" little Tepetlisaurus on the scene unless its human companion was nearby?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wroo?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: So you really are an accomplice to Saurian traffickers, and you ruined my perfect plan...

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Did you get close to Taruka just to kidnap Oberon? He praised you to the skies, you know. Think about how sad he'd be once he learns the truth.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: B—But we went there on the same day, and on Taruka's request too... Oh no, wait a second... No wonder Paran's voice felt familiar back then...

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: So you admit that you sneaked into my camp? That's terrifying. I didn't discover your presence at all!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you were just trying to box Paimon in! We only heard a little bit of the conversation a—and knocked over some crackers... It's not that serious, right?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: Paran, Lliwa, get them! We have to find out where Taruka and Oberon have been taken, no matter what!

choices.text: This isn't the part I'd like to play in this drama.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #They aren't listening to anything we're saying. {NICKNAME}, let's get out of here for now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It's not a good idea to get entangled with them right now...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After expending a lot of effort, you finally lose Lamizana and the others...

choices.text: That is such a sloppy plan.

talks.objective: Escape the pursuit and plan your next move
Return to the scene of the incident
Search for clues alongside your Saurian companion

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: You're here! Taruka has been telling me about how amazing you are. Says I should try my best to keep up with you in the race.

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: I mean, sheesh, doesn't think I can win at all, does he? Not a shred of regard for my dignity as his older sister at all!

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: So you can forget about me going easy on you in the race, and you shouldn't hold back either. Let's both do our best, and we'll see who's better!

choices.text: You'll regret making me get serious about this.

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Haha, now that's what I'm talking about!

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Anyway, enough talk. Let's start if you're ready.

choices.text: I'm just here for the participation prize.

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Haha! Bet you're just saying that to make me complacent. Not gonna work on me, ya hear?

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: I can't wait for the air race...

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Being able to sense the progress you and your Saurian partner have made is good for your training!

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: How are the preparations going?

dialogues.speaker: Paran
dialogues.text: Well, I guess... but are we really going to do this? Everything has to happen at very precise times...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: That will only make it seem more real and cover up many problems... In short, you won't go wrong so long as you listen to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paran
dialogues.text: If you say so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need time to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll wait.

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: We still have a few more flying challenges. Details are written on the board. Give 'em a try if you're keen... Of course, there are prizes to be won.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Honestly, I have no clue why it's called that. But speaking of Pakpaka... Have you ever heard the story of Kuntur and the evil sorcerer Rumi?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: The warriors of the tribe were defeated by that wicked mage, and he turned them into Pakpaka... which doesn't sound all that good. Maybe Pakpakas fly very quickly, or something — I don't know.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Haha... He's a good fighter, but not necessarily a good teacher. And as an opponent in flying competitions... I guess he's passable?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: But I mean, why would you come here if you didn't have issues with flying? So, if I were to be too strict... *sigh* Well, it's not like things like this have never happened in the past.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: That's why I focus on encouraging people nowadays. I'm sure that approach will get results just fine too.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: See you. You're welcome back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Cisik
dialogues.text: Welcome to Pakpaka Flying School!

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: We give all cadets the necessary guidance and help they need. Things have changed a lot, you know. Back in the day, students couldn't expect that kind of tender loving care.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: But then there was this one time when the coach was a little... strict with their words, and the student in question just happened to have quite a temper... *sigh* Yeah, that's not a fun one to talk about.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Anyway, our teaching policy's been shaken up since then. And I mean, nobody slaps a smiling face, and nobody hates compliments, am I right?

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Here's to a pleasant day!
